objective: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.

description: Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!
But be wary, <name>.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
progress: Did you find Garrick's shack? Are we finally free of that villain?
completion: Hah - you caught him! You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
